theorem_title: Greedy schedule indices stay within the candidate table
formal_statement: theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightLocalCoverSchedule.indices_lt (h : ℕ) {i : ℕ} (hi : i ∈ _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightLocalCoverSchedule.indices h) : i < _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightLocalCoverSchedule.rows h := by sorry
natural_language_statement:
Let $h\in\mathbb N$ and let $i$ be an index occurring in the concrete greedy local-cover schedule. If $R(h)$ is the number of radix-enumerated candidate maps, then

$$i<R(h).$$

This is the array-safety interface for reading candidate coefficients and histograms at every selected schedule occurrence.
